interpretation: Human-aligned approximate wrist correction, not physical precision calibration. Limits remain physical/raw bounds independent of coordinate compensation. Gripper units remain percentages.
dataset_action_contract: Record sent_action (actual driver-returned follower targets). Keep leader_action separate. A model trained in follower coordinates must not receive the leader wrist correction again.

leader_wrist_seam_rebase.source_raw_coordinates: Historical unmodified capture rows are converted only during replay.

leader_shoulder_elbow_seam_rebase.interpretation: Elbow -90.021978 deg offset cancels an encoder coordinate rebase; it is not a newly estimated physical joint bias. Follower target coordinates are preserved on the observed continuous motion branch.

performance_trial.interpretation: 60 Hz is a target until measured. Body relative goal error caps rise 2->5 degrees; gripper stays 2 percentage points. Native limiter uses current-frame observation, refreshing stale feedback before sending through native send_action. PID and calibration unchanged.

operator_confirmation.scope: User reports current following has no major issues; not precision metrology or learned-policy validation.
